notes.title: Biggest Update
notes.content:
Hello Hunters!
[p align="start"]A huge new patch has just landed, packed with game-changing content and quality-of-life improvements! Here’s what’s new:


[p align="start"]Double the Chaos: 20 New Card Upgrades!
[p align="start"]That's right, we're introducing 20 new ways to craft insane builds and break the game. With this update we've doubled the number of Card Upgrades available since launch! Here are a few to whet your appetite:

Chaos Seed: Enemies explode on death, turning crowded rooms into a glorious, chain-reacting firework display.

Vampire: Land a critical blow and you might just steal some life back, giving you the edge in a tough fight.

All Or Nothing: The ultimate glass cannon run. You have 1 HP. So does every enemy. Even bosses! Good luck.


[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/557e396893ba92d98744dcc9ea6f08287e41bdbb.gif"]


[p align="start"]These powerful new upgrades have a higher chance of appearing on the tougher difficulties. Which brings us to...


[p align="start"]Think You're Good? 3 Crushing New Difficulties!
[p align="start"]For the veterans who crave a true test of skill, we've added three new difficulty levels. They are brutally hard. To be perfectly honest, I'm not even sure the final difficulty is possible to beat. I'm challenging you all to prove me wrong. 😅



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/0b0d91ed167aa910b15064ddda0fcf4f983e67d4.png"]


[p align="start"]More Control Over Your Run
[p align="start"]We want to help you conquer these new challenges with strategy, not just luck.

The Card Fountain: You can now build this structure to reroll your Card Upgrade options a few times. It's the perfect tool to hunt for that one final piece of your dream build.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/8742500e1b9c72b209ef4a07ade721de540eb22e.png"]



The Magic Stone: Want to show off? Build the Magic Stone to track your best completion times on every difficulty and immortalize your greatest runs!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/4380fe038390b8e9dc2057ad05f72d96714e7931.png"]
[p align="start"]Play On Your Schedule: In-Run Saves!
[p align="start"]A much-requested feature is finally here! You can now safely quit the game in the middle of a run and pick it up right where you left off whenever you're ready to play again.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/aa1a3ba29d7af8c9ed83cdc7c5a00a4a5bb8feb1.gif"]


[p align="start"]Your feedback and support have been invaluable in shaping this update. Thank you so much for being an amazing community.
[p align="start"]Now get in there and show us what you can do.
Good luck, Hunter.

notes.title: 10 New Card Upgrades!
notes.content:
Hey guys! 👋
Danny here with a bunch of new updates!
The most important one is:

10 New Card Upgrades! 🃏🃏🃏
Some of these will allow you to regain health ❤️‍🩹 (you guys were asking for it quite vocally), while others will increase your damage 🗡️ output by 2x / 4x!!! Of course, nothing in this world is free, so you might have to deal with some nasty side effects 😰

Here’s a sneak peek of the new Cards:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/6713e229dd132d9ae6ef86191e7844601cefad05.gif

Save System improvements
Apart from that, I improved the Saving System - a couple of you had problems with the game not saving sometimes (I’m guessing because anti-virus was checking the save file during the saving process). This should no longer be an issue!  (If you encountered any issues with saving, please let me know and I will help you restore the savefile!)

Balance changes and Bug fixes
Additionally, I introduced some balance changes and fixed more pesky bugs.

Hope you had a fantastic month, and see you next time when I’ll introduce more difficulty settings!

xoxo,
Danny

notes.title: 🖍️ First batch of improvements! 🛠️
notes.content:
Hey guys,
First of all, thanks so much for playing! You're making my dreams come true! ♥️
Secondly, the first batch of improvements landed in Hollow Survivors!
Thanks to your feedback, the following changes were implemented:
- Player movement speed was increased.
- Sword attack distance and attack speed were increased.
- Bow damage was nerfed.
- Chinese translation was improved.
- Added a WeChat QR code for Chinese users to contact me.
- Added "spell indicators" for gamepad users to make aiming easier.
- You can also now attack with the right controller stick if that's what you prefer.
- Buffed the Dragon Boss and Krakos Boss (you guys complained they are too easy 😨).
- Made the "bad" ending a bit more clear.
- Done a lot of smaller things you suggested.
- Fixed a metric ton of bugs, thanks to your bug reports!

What can you expect in the future?
- Increasing the difficulty of the Palace floors.
- More card upgrades to choose from.
- More ways to regain health.
- More difficulty settings.

If you have any more feedback or ideas, please share them with me!
Thanks so much again for playing ♥️

notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.content:
Dear players

It's been another good month for Hollow Survivors.

Flower Floor
I've been working on a lot of things but the coolest one is the Flower Floor.
I don't know why, but the image of this floor appeared in my mind when I just started working on the game a couple years ago. I never had the time to implement it, but now, finally, I brought it to life. Flower Floor is not anything spectacular, there are no fancy enemies in there or anything like that. It's a calm, mysterious place that may reveal itself to battle-worn Hunters. An oasis of peace amidst chaos. Here it is in all its beautiful glory:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/520e387f3ca0582c5237de9b6b3ab5f0d4af0890.gif

Azulon - The Scourge of the Skies
Another boss fight is complete. This time, you'll be fighting Azulon - an old dragon guarding his crystal treasure - jumping on you from above and shooting fiery waves of projectiles. The way the waves are constructed makes it much harder to destroy with your attack - dodging is probably a safer bet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/48acc49b46521f2c8612f9d915e993e083464501.gif

Dialogue Translations
New dialogues were translated to more than 10 languages!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/027e66475e6c68048206c1b33fa84d546599049b.gif

Performance optimizations
I know this is much less sexy than adding new content, but sometimes you just need to grind through the boring work in order to get to the fun part. The game should now run better on low-end hardware which I'm super happy about! The optimizations should also make your laptop less hot when playing the game (for all my laptop gamers <3).
You can always optimize the game more, so I'll definitely work on more optimizations in the future, but I'm very happy with the first batch of optimizations for now.

Here's an example of one of the optimizations. Do you see the grey object names lighting up and then going grey again? This means that rather than getting destroyed and created again, they are created once and are getting reused, which is good for your computer! (similar to how reusing stuff in real world is cheaper than buying a new thing all the time, hah!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/a87144f69167160072c8300381ba48c728befc6d.gif

Take care and see you in a month!

xoxo,
Danny Deer

notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.content:
Hello Players! 🎮✨

 It’s been a while since our last devlog, but we want to assure you that development on the game has been in full swing! Today, we’re excited to share some of the progress we've made.

Updates Based on Your Feedback 📋💡

We’ve been listening closely to your thoughts on the prologue, and we’re thrilled to present some key changes and improvements. Some of these you might have already noticed if you're still exploring the Prologue—but others will be delightful surprises! 🎉

Here’s what’s new:

🎨 New Main Menu Artwork

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/bc6d732399d201d196d8dff9c53a2e292572452a.gif

🧠 Revamped Tutorials: We made them more intuitive and added new ones for better clarity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/0d2215b6c4ec04ebc75c1d1eec40938c6644b057.gif

🟥 Dash Indicators Updated: Based on your feedback, we changed the color from dark black to bright red for better visibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/c86dd2e170bf997173a1ff75d314d6184e893ee8.gif

🌲 Improved Spike Traps: They now blend naturally into the forest instead of resembling dungeon traps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/c1d7fac1b7815bb6710b7c26973e0d576c77abd5.jpg

🧊 Fixed Enemy Collisions in Lava Springs: No more enemies dipping into the lava! (Sorry, no GIF or screenshot this time!)
🃏 Card Selection Reminder: Can’t remember which cards you’ve picked? Press Tab to review your choices!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/8b7650a6935b17f194039cb6c74df536eb113aab.jpg

🎭 More Character Portraits: Variety is the spice of life!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/7a9904cffd80054a301a9a3d5fa2114805fee659.gif

🌌 Better Spirit UI: Thanks to your feedback, we’ve redesigned the spirit (mana) UI to make it more intuitive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/a1e5c99bb0eab51a85d9d25babcb874b6c69789f.gif

Of course, this is far from the end! 🚀🎮
In addition to the fixes and features you’re already familiar with, we’ve been hard at work on a host of brand-new surprises that no one has seen before.
These updates required plenty of focus and creativity from our team, and we’re confident that the new Bosses roaming the maps will add a thrilling dose of excitement to your adventures! 🐉⚔️


New Bosses Are Here! 🐉💥

We’ve poured our creativity into designing brand-new bosses to challenge and thrill you. Get ready to face:
1. Krakos 🐙

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/b7a816afc43bf6d4e359e4e753a4398dd60b83f8.gif


 The ancient ruler of the Void, corrupted by the Soulbinders’ crystal.
 Attacks by causing explosions on the water-like Void surface in a chessboard pattern.
 Dodge the explosive tiles to survive his wrath!

2. Soulbinder Leader 🔮

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/62b1c6bf9d315a951bc540b9fe4bf52b0fb18937.gif


 Founder of the Soulbinders cult and the game’s final boss.
 Attacks:
 Releases a barrage of projectiles in all directions.
 Summons magical spears that home in on the player.
 Executes swift dashes across the map to keep players on their toes.

3. The Dragon 🐉🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/e00fbdde2771eda5ac8326db14b3028b08847780.jpg


 Guardian of treasures in Lava Springs, now blinded by the crystal’s power.
 Attacks:[olist]
 Fires a cone-shaped barrage of projectiles.
 Summons falling meteorites.
 Performs powerful sky jumps to crush players.
[/olist]

New Enemies 😈
We’ve also introduced fearsome new foes to keep you on your toes:
Soulbinders
Devoted cultists who summon three floating daggers that instantly strike anything in their path. Watch out—these daggers don’t behave like normal projectiles!
Crystal Shard
A fragment of the powerful crystal, it spawns relentless crystal spiders until destroyed. Larger and tougher than earlier enemies, it’s a high-priority target for survival.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/c4bc4a648df71069907614a76487c6c91d3ee891.gif


Weapons and Extras 🗡️🏹
We’ve fine-tuned some exciting new weapons for release:
Greataxe, Bow, and Scythe: Each one crafted for epic battles (no sneak peeks yet—stay tuned!).
Other cool improvements:
💰 New Coin Pickup Animation: Collecting coins has never been more satisfying!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/621c75fd1b0bc430aa2aa28a952bf695c537c9fb.gif

Thank you so much for your incredible support and feedback—it fuels our journey and inspires us to keep improving. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy gaming! 🎮💖


Let me know if you’d like further tweaks! 😊

notes.title: New Enemies!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors! 👋

It’s been a while since you’ve heard from us but things got pretty dangerous so the information was delayed. Before we get to the scouts’ report we have an announcement to make.

We’ve received a lot of feedback pointing out the lacking parts in the tutorial. Now we’re happy to tell you that revamping the tutorial has been finished. Hopefully, the new features added will make it cover every basic you need so you’ll no longer find it lacking content! 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/46bf439a233e366c3e4ce046469431c810de9b60.gif

With that being said, the scouts spotted new dangerous creatures roaming the tower. Here’s what we’ve managed to find out about them thus far:

🛡️ Minotaur
Slow as it is, this monster can give even the strongest fighter a headache as its ability to block attacks with his shield is unparalleled. What’s more, his attacks are really powerful so you should do your best to avoid getting hit. 💪 It is one of the two new big monsters encountered on the Lava Floor. The other… we’ll talk about now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/1682d9b4417b5a41c1695d7fc763996924fe31d8.gif
👁️ Cyclops
It’s appearance spells doom to every foe he faces. Throwing stones with incredible precision and speed, the Cyclops is a truly terrifying enemy who’ll put your ability to dodge to the test. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/e1d2c2e99ece81e3beea5d15466263c05bb83363.gif
😱 Void Tentacles
While exploring the Void Floor, our scouts discovered a new, unsettling danger. Whole areas filled with void tentacles ready to strike you as soon as you come too close. Some of our people started wondering… are they but small independent organisms, or maybe part of some unspoken threat laying deep underneath the void’s surface? It might be the best if we never have to figure that out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/746c8a75614a22c8b6dfa1e3e2dea0c9cc73d449.gif
⚔️ New Floor: Holy Palace
Finally, after months of scouting, we’ve managed to find the path to the last floor. Holy Palace- the lair of the despicable Soulbinders. It is said that they were the ones responsible for making the tower crawl with monstrosities and no hollow can be free without slaying these oppressors. We’re yet to scout the area but this is footage of the capabilities of one of them. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/b369c4ed569b84969ac7c9bc0ae720842bdc81b5.gif

As you can see, we’ve made significant progress in our path to ascension. Please, let us know your thoughts on today’s devlog in the comments or on our discord! If you have any ideas or suggestions about the contents of the game make sure to let us know!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/46918699cc28f53541e68d81397679db602c9fea.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285940/Hollow_Survivors/ 

See you soon,
Hollow Survivors Team

notes.title: New Floor- the Void!
notes.content:
Hello Hollows! 👋

Welcome back to the new devlog from the hollow lands. This month the developer discovered the entrance to the new floor- the Void so today we’d like to show you his discoveries! 🔍


1. New Enemy- Corrupted Totem 🗿
You guys got used to enemies with projectiles? Well, this one is different. Corrupted Totem uses the void to create an explosion right under your feet. Be careful and don't let them catch you off guard! This enemy can prove to be deadly in cooperation with other foes, forcing you to make moves you’d rather avoid! ☠️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/8e6c008c6b3507f8df866437b878e678c032df56.gif
2. New Enemy- Ethereal Bull 🐂
"Okay, it'll probably run towards me then stop... no, it didn't stop, maybe now? WHEN DOES IT STOP?!" - This one is tough. Ethereal Bull is a relentless being that will chase you until you're defeated. It requires some skill to avoid it during the chaos of the fight, especially when projectiles fly your way and the ground is about to explode under your feet! ⚠️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/d7eacb9656041cd5faea6949616301d878770bfb.gif
3. New Flood- The Void
New map with even harder, unpredictable enemies. Besides normal monsters, you’ll also have to face the creatures of the void- twisted by the vast emptiness who’re hostile to every intruder. We’ve only seen their glimpse and to give you an accurate report of their abilities and looks, more observation is needed. 📝

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/1349938a909d9cb3606623d05920bcb8451c0100.gif
4. New Defeat Animation 😢
Some of you gave us the feedback that the defeat screen is not showing the correct info, so we updated it with a brand new look. It'll look even better when the UI update drops!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/3c5b99907780d5387234205fb8f6b3e681610eb0.gif
That’s it for today! We hope you’ve enjoyed the novelties and the new enemies will make the gameplay experience even more satisfying! 🤩 Don’t forget to join our discord community and if you’d like to support the game’s development, you can add it to your wishlists on Steam! 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/46918699cc28f53541e68d81397679db602c9fea.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285940/Hollow_Survivors/

See you soon,
Hollow Survivors Team

notes.title: Card Archive
notes.content:
Hello Survivors! 👋

Welcome to the new devlog straight from the hollow lands! Today, we’ve got a lot of things to talk about. Some of which are topics frequently mentioned by a lot of you on different occasions! Without further ado, let’s take a look! 🔎

Card Archive 📓
It’s one of the most frequently asked for features. From now on, you’ll be able to take a look at the cards you’ve picked during the run. This will undoubtedly help you to craft your builds! 🙂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/4150cf3b91d42a1b4ba5ec2d451d75c4c8525247.gif
Translations
We’ve translated the game to 12 different languages! This is a shout out to all the members of our community who would like to play in languages other than English.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/8fe62adff90bff9cdd3d29de50e83851888808cb.gif
New weapon- Scythe
This weapon is a real treat for all of you who’d like to feel like a true grim reaper. ⚰️ The attack pattern consists of three hits in a combo. The first 2 are quite narrow and deal a medium amount of damage. The third though is a completely different matter. It’s a huge AOE attack- perfect way to finish off this combo and if you manage to position yourself correctly, you’ll deal a LOT of damage. 💪

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/baa69f0b39e0450783d0bef8fca79604b87c3f69.gif
Soul Essence 👻
This is a new in-game resource which has an important purpose- weapon upgrades. 🔨 Make sure you move quickly, because once the enemy is slain, his essence drops and you only have some time till it disappears completely!

notes.title: New weapon
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

We’re happy to see you again. Today we’d like to continue a topic mentioned in the previous devlog- the Lava Floor 🌋 as well as introduce two new spells, a new weapon and an exciting feature which will tremendously impact your gameplay! Let’s take a look, shall we? 👀

Lava Floor
In this hellish landscape only the strongest monsters shall survive. 💪 Therefore, it’s not surprising that enemies you’ll get to face on this floor will have considerably higher hp and more challenging attack patterns. ⚔️ To make defeating the monsters more satisfying we’ve introduced an improved AI which makes the enemies smarter. 🧠

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/7b134f263561622651a4ad65442c6238d1569382.gif
Today, we’d like to introduce you to three enemies you’ll encounter on these lands. The first one shoots a barrage of bullets once every few seconds but is immobile. The second- giant skull 💀 will charge at the players and their considerable size makes them harder to dodge without dashing. The last enemy we want to show you is the minotaur- a creature known for its great defense. Armed with a sturdy shield he’ll block every attack coming from the guarded direction. Use your agility to maneuver around him and deal a clean hit. 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/d6f84dc71ba36deaf48ab1d6e7ae76bd45f852f9.gif
Two new spells
That’s right! We’re introducing two new spells to give you more diversity while creating your builds! 🔥 The first one is called Explosion Curse. It’s a curse cast on an area which causes the area to explode after a moment. 💥 This spell, although very powerful in terms on pure damage will require you to predict the movement of your enemies to showcase the full capabilities of this ability.

The other spell is the Wave Blast. A highly concentrated blast of energy which hits enemies just outside of your melee range. Keep in mind that this spell will not hit enemies which are too far or too close so keeping a proper distance and planning your movement carefully is of utmost importance when using this ability. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/885823ecf981b581fd724a50fe1b5474958570ba.gif
New weapon- Bow
That’s right! We’re introducing a new ranged weapon for all of you who want to strike your enemies from a distance. 🏹 Keep in mind that this considerable range comes at a price of lower damage and slower fire rate.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/9f11a740396aa2bf78bdadcbdcada0afb032a044.gif
New Feature- Multiple upgrades
Previously, you could only choose one upgrade from each category (attack, spell, dash). 📝 Now, you can equip up to 2 upgrades of the same type and make some interesting combinations! 🤩 There is a small catch to it- the second upgrade of the same category will have its effectiveness lowered by 50%. That’s why the order will also become an important factor while developing your hollowed fighters. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/ef1e06501651383b77f111caa51d70acbd20717a.gif
That’s it for today! We can’t wait to hear your opinion on the contents of this devlog, so let us know in the comments below or on discord! 👇 If you enjoy our work, please add the game to your wishlists on Steam to not miss on any future update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/46918699cc28f53541e68d81397679db602c9fea.png 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285940/Hollow_Survivors/ 

See you soon,
Hollow Survivors Team

notes.title: New floor
notes.content:
Hello Survivors! 👋

Welcome to our first monthly devlog! 🙂 First and foremost, we’d like to thank all of you for the suggestions, opinions and all the feedback you’ve given us throughout the entire Scream Fest. 💝 We’ll take our time to think of the best way to address your concerns and ideas, so you can look forward to the future devlogs! 

Today, we're excited to show you the new features we've been busy with. We're always eager to hear what you think, so please share your thoughts with us. 🔥 Let's jump right into the updates! 

 1. Forest floors decorations 🌳 
Your feedback was loud and clear – the forest levels seemed a bit too dull and empty. We hear you, and we agree. That’s why we've spruced up these areas with vibrant new decorations! During the visual upgrade, we made sure to keep the unique spirit of the hollow tower alive. 👻 Let us know that you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/5ba5d5503d762e1e6047d4102d266c56b124809e.gif
2. New weapon “Great Axe” 🪓 
To make another step towards ensuring that every Survivor has a weapon suitable for their desired playstyle, we’re adding a new one. Great Axe is a melee weapon with a bigger range and much bigger damage ( 40 -> 50 -> 80, while sword deals 25 damage per hit). It’s grievous damage doesn’t come without a cost though, as swinging a weapon of such size is surely a great effort which comes with a considerably slower attack rate. Let's discuss how this changes your strategy on Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/d33deb2c18517266715faf5bb60ddebcffd8ef10.gif
3. New floor - Stone&Lava 🌋 
Brace yourself for the stone & lava floor, a perilous blend of rock and molten danger, complete with a formidable new boss. The Beholder - guardian of this realm will challenge you with his lasers and myriad bullets. Keep in mind the boss is still in testing and adjustments and upgrades to the balance will be made. 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/cabe6288e76e98835208eec86ba0ca54072f807d.gif
4. Meta progression- merchant 💰 
Our beloved merchant also received some changes. We’ve introduced an upgrade mechanism which allows you to help him (through a hefty donation) expand the range of the goods he offers with better, more powerful upgrades. 💪

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/178f0a15233eda1a0e346d68b184ae7077e46bf7.gif
5. Updated visuals 👀 
We’ve also improved the looks of the level up mechanism, added an entirely new animation and made the upgrade cards darker (and way cooler). In our opinion, small details like these make all the difference.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/4bcd724003efd6099fc7813b5aaa39593f50345e.gif
Thank you for reading the entire devlog. We can’t wait to hear from you on our discord! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43555301/46918699cc28f53541e68d81397679db602c9fea.png

If you’re enjoying our work thus far and would like to support us, you can add the game to your wishlists on Steam! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285940/Hollow_Survivors/ 

See you soon,
Hollow Survivors Team
